ranked_approaches.label: Fine-tuning (LoRA or full)
reasons: If prompting plateaus, fine-tuning teaches a new skill directly
Light LoRA fine-tuning is viable but gains over few-shot may be marginal
One-time/static knowledge is fine to bake into fine-tuned weights
Single GPU is sufficient for LoRA fine-tuning of small/mid models

ranked_approaches.label: Prompting / Chain-of-Thought
reasons: Task shape is new skill -> try prompting/CoT first
Small example count favors few-shot prompting first
Flexible latency keeps prompting/RAG's fast iteration loop attractive

ranked_approaches.label: Multimodal / Agent Architecture
reasons: Multimodal/agent SFT typically needs multi-GPU (3x80GB+ in tutorial)

ranked_approaches.label: Alignment Training (RLHF/PPO)
reasons: PPO needs ~2x base model memory (policy + reference); tight on a single GPU

safety_note: Cooperative/internal use: standard prompting-safety practices are likely sufficient.
